name: Skooma Cat's Playthings
intro: Presenting the past to keep from repeating the present in the future. Keep up, plaything.

puzzles.name: Prey
puzzles.flavor: This is a story about my favorite topic: the power of knowledge.
solution: Play Preying Elytra and select Portcullis.
Play Morkul Gatekeeper and select Portcullis.
Play Duel Atop the World on Preying Elytra.
Play Fighters Guild Steward, select Preying Elytra, then select Portcullis.
Attack your opponent with Arcanaeum Librarian.
puzzles.notes: UESP does not list the deck; the solution needs four draws (Arcanaeum Librarian 0 -> 4 power), so the deck holds four filler cards.

puzzles.name: Shambles
puzzles.flavor: Sheogorath has brought many abominations to this land. This story involves one of the most misbegotten of all.
solution: Play Dres Tormentor.
Play Icy Shambles and select Revered Guardian.
Play Quicksilver Crossbow on Icy Shambles, selecting Blacksap Protector.
Attack your opponent with Stoutheart Giant.

puzzles.name: Shining
puzzles.flavor: Sheogorath's saints have many talents.
solution: Play Shining Saint and select Stampede Sentinel.
Play Close Call on Shining Saint.
Play Shining Saint and select Revered Guardian.
Play Spiteful Dremora and select Revered Guardian.
Play Mecinar's Will on Fighters Guild Recruit.
Attack Stampede Sentinel with Fighters Guild Recruit.
Attack your opponent with Cheydinhal Sapper.
Play Lightning Bolt on your opponent.

puzzles.name: Driven
puzzles.flavor: Strange things happen to minds in these isles. Take this as a cautionary tale.
solution: Play Improvised Weapon on Night Talon Lord.
Attack Candlehearth Brawler with Night Talon Lord.
Play Daedric Dagger on Candlehearth Brawler.
Attack Hive Defender with Candlehearth Brawler.
Play World-Eater's Eyrie.
Play Squish the Wimpy on Night Talon Lord, targeting Swiftwing Dragon.
Attack your opponent with Swiftwing Dragon.
Play Drive Mad on Swiftwing Dragon.
Play Soul Tear.
Play Swiftwing Dragon and attack your opponent with it.

puzzles.name: Order
puzzles.flavor: Ah. This tale takes me back to the old days, when my master Jyggalag roamed this land.
solution: Play Grappling Hook on Mudcrab Anklesnapper, selecting one Evermore Steward.
Play Knight of Order in the Field Lane.
Play one Dragon Priest Mask, Orcish Warhammer, and both Redoran Battlespear on Mudcrab Anklesnapper.
Attack your opponent with Mudcrab Anklesnapper.
Play Dragon Priest Mask on Knight of Order.
Play Master of Arms.
Play Squish the Wimpy on Master of Arms, selecting the silenced Evermore Steward in the Field Lane.

puzzles.name: The Bigger They Are
puzzles.flavor: Do be careful, sir. Quite a few people have been squished by falling giants.
solution: Play Tiny Dragon in the Field Lane.
Play Summerset Shieldmage in the Shadow Lane.
Play Skaven Pyromancer in the Shadow Lane.
Attack your opponent with all five Niben Bay Cutthroats.

puzzles.name: Weakness
puzzles.flavor: These isles are no place for the weak. Honestly they're barely a place for anyone.
solution: Play Grappling Hook on Rihad Horseman, selecting Awakened Imperfect.
Play Weakness on an Awakened Imperfect.
Attack the weakened Awakened Imperfect with Rihad Horseman.
Attack your opponent with your remaining creatures.

puzzles.name: Darkest Hour
puzzles.text: Survive for one turn to win.
puzzles.flavor: Next, you are to die for my master's amusement. Unless you'd rather not.
solution: Play Dark Seducer in the Field Lane.
Play Bone Bow on the Target in the Field Lane, selecting Reclusive Giant to Silence.
Attack a Young Mammoth with the Target.
End Turn.

puzzles.name: Spite
puzzles.flavor: Your murderous abilities and bottomless spite never fail to amuse me, sir.
solution: Play Squish the Wimpy on Seething Flesh Golem, targeting the Target in the Shadow Lane.
Attack any of the opponents creatures with Seething Flesh Golem.
Attack your opponent with your remaining creatures.

puzzles.name: Seeking Trouble
puzzles.text: Your deck is empty. Win this turn.
puzzles.flavor: Good news, sir! Your next task is going to be extremely painful. Well, it's good news for me, anyway.
solution: Play Cast Out on Auroran Sentry.
Play East Empire Crafter.
Play Trouble Seeker, targeting a Fortress Watchman.
Play the Prophecy Cast Out on Trouble Seeker.
Play Trouble Seeker, targeting a Fortress Watchman.
Play the Prophecy Cast Out on Trouble Seeker.
Play Trouble Seeker, targeting a Fortress Watchman.
Play the Prophecy Cast Out on the last Fortress Watchman.
Attack your opponent with all creatures.
Play Rayvat the Mage.
Play Close Call on Afflicted Alit.
Play Afflicted Alit.
puzzles.notes: The player keeps the runes at 15, 10 and 5 health (16 health): the solution draws a Prophecy Cast Out (shuffled in by Therana) from each rune Trouble Seeker breaks.

puzzles.name: Keep the Gate
puzzles.text: Survive for one turn to win.
puzzles.description: Close the gate on their attack.
puzzles.flavor: Have ye met me Gatekeeper? He's a lovely fellow. Never met a head he wouldn't smash.
solution: Play Dune Smuggler in the Shadow Lane, targeting the Deadly Draugr.
Play Move in Shadows on The Gatekeeper.
Attack the two Iron Atronachs using the two Deadly Draugr.
There are two options: play Elixir of Conflict, then use it on The Gatekeeper; or play Fell the Mighty on a Vigilant Giant.
End turn.

puzzles.name: Bawk Bawk Bawk
puzzles.flavor: What's the only thing funnier than a chicken? Even bigger chickens!
solution: Play Ring of Namira.
Play Felldew on the Hive Defender.
Attack Hive Defender with Giant Chicken.
Attack Pointy Wall of Spikes with Giant Chicken.
Play both Blessing of the Grove.
Attack Hive Defender with one Golden Initiate, and your opponent with the other.

puzzles.name: Torture Fun
puzzles.flavor: Time for me favorite pastime: torturing people for fun! Don't worry, they like it.
solution: Attack your opponent with all three Moon Sugar Smuggler in the Shadow Lane.
Attack a Colovian Trooper with the Moon Sugar Smuggler in the Field Lane.
Play Drain Blood on the Bedeviling Scamp, Betray a Moon Sugar Smuggler, and target the Bedeviling Scamp again.
Play the two Soul Split on the two Moon Sugar Smuggler.
Play the three Curse on the two Colovian Trooper.
Play Blood Sacrament, and Betray a Sundered Shade.
Attack your opponent with your remaining creatures.

puzzles.name: Manic
puzzles.flavor: All I've ever wanted is to see ye unlock yer true potential. And cheese, obviously. And to bathe in the tears of crying ducks. And a raise, because I've earned it!
solution: Play Mentor of the Watch, and select Manic Jack.
Play Manic Jack and Redoran Forerunner in the same lane as Mentor of the Watch.
Play Daedric Dagger on Redoran Forerunner.
Play Mentor's Ring on Redoran Forerunner.
Attack Fighters Guild Recruit with Mentor of the Watch.
Use both Elixir of Conflict on Redoran Forerunner.
Attack your opponent with Redoran Forerunner.
Play Lady Syl's Cruelty on Redoran Forerunner.
Play Royal Sage and Wisdom of Ancients.
Play Manic Mutation on Manic Jack.
Attack with Manic Jack.

puzzles.name: A Bard's Tale
puzzles.flavor: They say all artists have to be a wee bit crazy. But why settle for a wee bit, eh?
solution: Attack your opponent with the Golden Saint and both Crazed Hungers.
Play Odirniran Necromancer in the Field Lane, sacrificing a Crazed Hunger.
Attack with the Crazed Hunger.
Play Firebolt on the Crazed Hunger in the Shadow Lane.
Play Lady Syl's Cruelty on the Golden Saint.
Play Abnur Tharn in the Shadow Lane. Select Odirniran Necromancer with Abnur Tharn's ability, then select Golden Saint from the Discard pile.
Play Lady Syl's Cruelty on the Golden Saint in the Field Lane.
Play Brilliant Experiment on Abnur Tharn.
Play Lady Syl's Cruelty on Abnur Tharn.

Play Abnur Tharn in the Shadow Lane. Select Odirniran Necromancer with Abnur Tharn's ability, then select Abnur Tharn from the Discard pile; select Odirniran Necromancer with Abnur Tharn's ability, then select Golden Saint from the Discard pile.
Attack with Luzrah gro-Shar.

puzzles.name: Expert Opinion
puzzles.description: Demonstrate the expertise of the Guildsworn.
puzzles.flavor: The Daggerfall Covenant wants us to test the mettle of their troops. I'm sure they have a weakness in their formation.
solution: Play Elixir of Conflict, and use it on Pointy Wall of Spikes.
Attack Pointy Wall of Spikes with Renowned Instructor.
Play Guildsworn Oathman and Fighters Guild Berserker.
Play Improvised Weapon on Guildsworn Bloodluster.
End turn, then target Pointy Wall of Spikes with Guildsworn Bloodluster's ability.

puzzles.name: Mobilized for War
puzzles.description: Mobilize a defense for the Daggerfall Covenant.
puzzles.flavor: Empire troops on the horizon! We don't have much to work with; can you find a way to take them out?
solution: Play Sparksmith in the Field Lane.
Play both Improvised Weapons on Recruit.
Attack the Colovian Trooper with Recruit.
Play Staff of Ice in the Shadow Lane, selecting the Recruit in the Field Lane as the target.
Play Salvage, selecting Improvised Weapon.
Play both Improvised Weapons on Recruit.
Play Telekinesis on Emeric's Warlord.
Attack your opponent with Emeric's Warlord.

puzzles.name: Powering Up
puzzles.description: Empower the spells of the Aldmeri Dominion.
puzzles.flavor: These Ebonheart Pact fools dare face our destructive magic? Obliterate them!
solution: Attack Blacksap Protector with Dominion Battlereeve.
Play Forked Bolt and Firebolt on Trouble Seeker.
Play Fingers of the Mountain on Trouble Seeker; play the second stage on Risen Dead and the third stage on Colovian Trooper.
Attack opponent with Ancano.
Play Channeled Storm on Trouble Seeker.

puzzles.name: Empress's New Recruits
puzzles.description: Display the might of the Empire of Cyrodiil.
puzzles.flavor: This town claims allegiance to the Aldmeri Dominion. Convince them of the error of their ways.
solution: Play Euraxia Tharn in the Field Lane, selecting Ring of Namira.
Play both Bruma Profiteers in the Shadow Lane.
Play A Night to Remember on Euraxia Tharn, then select Manic Jack with her Summon ability.
Play Bewildering Speed on Manic Jack, then select the Recruit in the Shadow Lane.
Play Defense of Bruma.
Attack your opponent with Manic Jack.
Play Blades Flanker in the Shadow Lane, sacrificing Euraxia Tharn. Select any creature in the Field Lane.
Attack your opponent with all remaining creatures.
End turn.
puzzles.notes: The opponent's Manic Jack "with Charge" was given that Charge, so it starts 4/4 (Manic Jack gains +1/+1 per keyword gained); with it the documented line is exactly lethal.

puzzles.name: Battle Hardened
puzzles.description: Let the veterans of the Ebonheart Pact lead you to victory.
puzzles.flavor: Come. Help our veteran troops teach the Guildsworn a thing or two about resourcefulness.
solution: Play Galyn the Shelterer in the Shadow Lane, selecting Black Marsh Centurion.
Play Mournhold Taskmaster and Berserker of the Pale in the Shadow Lane.
Play Invoker of the Hist in the Field Lane and attack the Hive Defender.
Play Jorunn's Vanguard in the Shadow Lane and attack the Hive Defender.
Play Rapid Shot on the Hive Defender in the Shadow Lane.
Play the powered up Black Marsh Centurion in the Field Lane.
Play Steel-Eyed Visionary in the Field Lane and attack the Hive Defender.
Attack the Hive Defender with Black Marsh Centurion.
Play Squish the Wimpy on Black Marsh Centurion, selecting the Hive Defender in the Shadow Lane.
